plan: To prioritize capital preservation, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces overall portfolio risk by eliminating leveraged positions and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more limited upside potential.

plan: Trim all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) to reduce overall leverage and meet the 15% combined limit.

balanced.read: The balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. This approach seeks a middle ground between capital preservation and aggressive growth, with moderate volatility.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) to 6% each, leaning into higher-beta positions.
Buy CRCL at 6% to add a high-scoring scanner setup for aggressive growth.
This plan aims to stretch growth by utilizing leverage and concentrating in strong setups.
Strict stop discipline is crucial for managing the amplified risk.
aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware this approach carries substantially higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and the daily decay/rebalancing effects of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is paramount.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero to eliminate high-beta exposure.

income.read: The income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It eliminates leveraged and high-beta positions, rotating into income-generating ETFs.
